subject: literacy
concept: Self-correcting when a decoded word doesn't make sense in the sentence
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student reads a sentence where a decoding mistake creates a nonsensical result, and is prompted to notice and fix it
exercise.pictorial: Student compares a 'makes sense' vs 'doesn't make sense' version of a sentence
exercise.abstract: Student catches and self-corrects their own misread word during independent reading

assessment.mastery_threshold: self-corrects at least 3 of 4 planted misread scenarios
misconception_flags: continues reading past an error without noticing the sentence stopped making sense

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
